criteria.text: Same stored SHA-256 corpus is used; Docling-native RapidOCR result is scored against all 36 labels; report recall at similarity 0.8, mean character similarity, small-label recovery, wall time, peak RSS/cgroup result, and timeout/OOM state. Add a product profile only if recall >=95%, mean similarity >=0.90, small labels >=15/16, wall <180s, RSS <2.8 GiB, and projected service <4 GiB; otherwise close this child by measurement and leave mc2-3gz2m open.
